context.purpose: Solve steady heat flow through layered slabs or DC current through layered resistors from material and boundary intent; publish independently verified field and flux tables and optional sampled-limit margins.
context.assumptions: Stable GetDP 3.5.0, serial linear nodal finite elements, metres and constant cross-sectional area. Thermal field is kelvin, conductivity W/(m K), source W/m3, flux W/m2; electrical field V, conductivity S/m, source A/m3 and current density A/m2. Flux is outward at either boundary and positive along +x in element tables.
context.constraints: One to sixteen perfectly contacting constant-property layers, two to 128 cells each and 512 total. Stiffness contrast at most 1e8. At least one value or thermal convection boundary anchors the field. No arbitrary .pro files, imported meshes, 2D/3D, radiation, transient, nonlinear/coupled electrothermal or MPI. Limits inspect mesh-node field and element-midpoint flux only.
context.inspection: field.csv retains node positions and temperature/potential; flux.csv retains element centres, signed axial flux and one-based layer indices. conduction-summary.json reports source-corrected boundary outflow, global balance, exact-solution discrepancies, units, losses and limit margins. model.pro and model.msh are generated inspectable solver inputs.
context.recovery: UNANCHORED_FIELD: supply a value or thermal convection end. INVALID_BOUNDARY: value/flux needs value only; convection needs coefficient and ambient. INVALID_TEMPERATURE: use nonnegative kelvin. ILL_CONDITIONED_FIELD: reduce conductivity/element-size contrast. PERFORMANCE_NOT_MET: inspect signed margins, change material/source/boundary or documented limits, then rerun. Configure stable 3.5.0 for INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND/UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME; retain native logs on failure.

lifecycle.timeout: One deadline bounds version identification, solve, fresh-process postprocessing and final verification; shared process-tree supervisor terminates timed-out commands.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned-process cancellation plus final cancellation gate; no resident solver.
lifecycle.logs: Retains version, solve and reopen stdout/stderr, deterministic formulation/mesh, authored/effective plans, native .pre/.res and original/reopened .pos fields, tables, summary and failed results.
lifecycle.verification: Independent piecewise-quadratic exact conduction transfer equations check all native node fields and element-midpoint flux, source-corrected end and interface conservation. Fresh GetDP process reloads .pre/.res and regenerates fields. Offline verifier reconstructs generated inputs, publication membership, evidence hashes and analytic expectations.
